legacy.claim: **Kill condition B:** the coupled two-substance vacuum supports a single Maxwell photon sector (one speed, two transverse polarizations, no birefringence, no detectable frame, γ = 1 via flow drag)
legacy.evidence: Stated as the theorem owed, with the Volovik Fermi-point theorem as the standard of proof ([studies/superfluid-vacuum-and-emergent-gauge-fields](../../studies/superfluid-vacuum-and-emergent-gauge-fields.md)). ORB-11219: the existing packet Hamiltonian is not a candidate — its linearized symbol is two longitudinal sounds plus frozen transverse currents; equal c₊=c₋ degenerates those cones without producing Maxwell polarizations ([packet-hamiltonian-linearization](packet-hamiltonian-linearization.md), [studies/maxwell-mode-content-and-two-fluid-acoustics](../../studies/maxwell-mode-content-and-two-fluid-acoustics.md)). The analytic attempt ([photon-mode-obstruction](photon-mode-obstruction.md)) also excludes speed matching and Josephson locking as sufficient Maxwell mechanisms in a regular isotropic phase-only action; locking attaches walls to relative-winding charge ([studies/two-component-phase-locking](../../studies/two-component-phase-locking.md)). These are failures of the stated scalar-density and phase-only apparatuses, not a no-go for every two-component order-parameter theory. The nature claim stays untested; additional gauge structure is outside the calculation. Binding measurements if a later sector fails: birefringence ξ < 1 × 10⁻¹⁶ (GRB 140206A), resonator anisotropy 10⁻¹⁷–10⁻¹⁸ per rest frame (×2 frames + relative flow), GRB dispersion, and the inherited ORB-10156 γ = 1 floor ([studies/lorentz-violation-bounds](../../studies/lorentz-violation-bounds.md))
legacy.kill: Birefringence, two sound speeds, resonator anisotropy, or γ ≠ 1. Binding walls already measured if it fails.
